qa_pair.question: Consider only Mautic contacts tagged "mcp-test". Summing lead points per company (ignore contacts without a company), which company has the highest total? Answer with the company name only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test", some attended the webinar held in August 2026. Of those attendees, the one who was active most recently lives in which city? Answer with the city name only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test", exactly one contact is blocked from email because messages to them hard-bounced. Which company does that contact work for? Answer with the company name only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test" that are assigned to a Mautic user (have an owner), which one has the fewest points? Answer with their last name only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test" that are on a trial, how many are located in Japan and can still be emailed (no do-not-contact entry)? Answer with a number only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test" that have any recorded activity, whose last activity is the oldest? Answer with that contact's email address only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test" who subscribe to the newsletter and are based outside Japan, who has the most points? Answer with their first name only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test", find the company that has exactly two contacts. On what date was the higher-scoring of those two contacts last active? Answer in YYYY-MM-DD format.
True or False: every contact tagged "mcp-test" who works at Acme Corp and is on a trial has a do-not-contact entry for email. Answer True or False only.
Among contacts tagged "mcp-test", what is the total number of points of the contacts that have no company set? Answer with a number only.
